quizSubtitle: Week 3: At Aurecon: Wood is Good!

questions.name: Western Australian Maritime Museum
questions.clue: With a timber roof spanning more than 60 metres, this building is home to the yacht that ended the USA's 132-year America's Cup winning streak.

questions.name: Gaia (Nanyang Technological University)
questions.clue: This was the largest mass timber building in Asia when completed.

questions.name: 25 King Street
questions.clue: When completed in 2018, it was one of the world's tallest engineered timber office buildings.

questions.name: NMIT Arts & Media Building
questions.clue: Winner of an IStructE Award for pioneering damage-avoidance seismic design in a timber building.
